title: A/P Summary ages a vendor credit by its own date
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Vendor Y has only one open document: an unused $12.00 vendor credit created on day C (at least 62 days ago).
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/P Aging Summary" in the left list.
  3. Set the date chip to C + 1.
  4. Read vendor Y's row.
  5. Set the date chip to C + 61.
  6. Read vendor Y's row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 4:

  • $-12.00 under 1-30 Days; nothing under Current.

Step 6:

  • $-12.00 under 61-90 Days.

Why this matters: Vendor credits must reduce the right aging bucket.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), api/src/Reporting/Dashboard/Infrastructure/Doctrine/AccountPayable/Service/DbalApAgingSummaryFetcher.php:139-143. V1 code, quoted: `SUM(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, vc.date_created, :asOfDate) <= 30 THEN ... END) AS creditDays1to30`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-034) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v11 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Not yet checked against any build.

AUTOMATION: READY
